notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}
description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting Great Oak Guardian from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
